who.value: Logged-in user who both buys and sells

job.value: Get an overview of their account and jump to the right area

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My account' highlighted in the sidebar and the '@carousell_research' profile card make it clearly the account hub.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: There's no main action; two promo banners ('Me page just got an upgrade!', 'Go ad-free with Carousell Plus!') take the space right under the profile.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'View profile' and 'Subscribe now →' are clear, but the 'Start' link doesn't say what it starts.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Me page' is app vocabulary on a web page and 'Chat vs spend' leans on its ⓘ.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Insights, My sales and My listings each show a summary with a › into the full page.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Two promotional banners stacked above the person's own Insights and sales push their own account content down.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Numbers ('71 Total listing clicks') and section titles carry it; banner text is a line each.
